# Introduction

Milo tests differential abundance (DA) by fitting a negative-binomial GLM on cell counts within KNN neighbourhoods across conditions. Neighbourhoods that are enriched or depleted in Het mCh+ or Het mCh- cells relative to WT are identified at a spatial FDR threshold, and their UMAP positions reveal which cell states are affected by the mutation.

```{r setup}
library(Seurat)
library(miloR)
library(miloDE)
library(SingleCellExperiment)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggrepel)
library(patchwork)
library(DT)
library(htmltools)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(targets)
source(file.path("src/R/scrna-seq_utilities.R"))
```

```{r helpers}
plot_milo_contrasts_single <- function(res, fdr = 0.1) {
  da        <- res$da_results
  clust_var <- res$cluster_col

  clust_order <- da %>%
    dplyr::group_by(.data[[clust_var]]) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(med_lfc = median(logFC, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
    dplyr::arrange(med_lfc) %>%
    dplyr::pull(.data[[clust_var]])
  da[[clust_var]] <- factor(da[[clust_var]], levels = clust_order)

  plotDAbeeswarm(da, group.by = clust_var, alpha = 0.5) +
    ggplot2::scale_color_gradient2(
      low  = scales::muted("blue"),
      mid  = "white",
      high = scales::muted("red")) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey50") +
    labs(title = paste(res$model_contrast, "— beeswarm"),
         x = "Cluster", y = "log2 FC") +
    theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
}

da_table <- function(res, caption = "") {
  clust_var <- res$cluster_col
  if (is.null(clust_var) || is.na(clust_var))
    clust_var <- grep("^sNN_", colnames(res$da_results), value = TRUE)[1]

  res$da_results %>%
    dplyr::arrange(SpatialFDR) %>%
    dplyr::select(Nhood, all_of(clust_var), logFC, PValue, SpatialFDR) %>%
    dplyr::rename(Cluster = all_of(clust_var)) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(across(where(is.numeric), \(x) round(x, 4))) %>%
    DT::datatable(caption = caption, rownames = FALSE,
                  options = list(pageLength = 15, scrollX = TRUE)) %>%
    DT::formatStyle("SpatialFDR",
                    backgroundColor = DT::styleInterval(0.1, c("#fff0f0", "white")))
}

lfc_nhood_scatter <- function(da_neg, da_pos, clust_col, title = "",
                              lim = 10, subset_clusts = NULL) {
  df <- data.frame(
    mch_neg = da_neg$logFC,
    mch_pos = da_pos$logFC,
    clust   = da_neg[[clust_col]]
  )
  if (!is.null(subset_clusts)) df <- dplyr::filter(df, clust %in% subset_clusts)

  ggplot(df) +
    geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, colour = "black", linewidth = 0.5, lty = 2) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, colour = "black", linewidth = 0.5, lty = 2) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, colour = "black", linewidth = 0.5, lty = 2) +
    ggpointdensity::geom_pointdensity(aes(mch_neg, mch_pos), size = 1.2) +
    scale_color_viridis_c(name = "Cell density") +
    scale_x_continuous(name = "mChNeg vs WT  (Milo log FC)", limits = c(-lim, lim)) +
    scale_y_continuous(name = "mChPos vs WT  (Milo log FC)", limits = c(-lim, lim)) +
    labs(title = title) +
    coord_fixed() +
    theme_bw(base_size = 11)
}
```

# Data preview {#sec-data-preview}

UMAP of the combined HSC object with cluster labels (res 0.9) and per-condition split, to support interpretation of Milo DA results below.

```{r preview-load}
targets::tar_load(mpn_processed_hsc_fullcc)
clust_col_preview <- grep("sNN_pca.*_res\\.0\\.9$",
                          colnames(mpn_processed_hsc_fullcc@meta.data), value = TRUE)[1]
```

```{r preview-umap-clusters, fig.height=6, fig.width=14}
p_cl <- DimPlot(mpn_processed_hsc_fullcc, group.by = clust_col_preview,
                reduction = "umap.nn", label = TRUE, label.size = 7) +
  NoLegend() + labs(title = "HSC clusters (res 0.9)")

p_cond <- DimPlot(mpn_processed_hsc_fullcc, group.by = "sample.name",
                  reduction = "umap.nn") +
  labs(title = "HSC — condition")

p_cl | p_cond
```

```{r preview-umap-split, fig.height=6, fig.width=18}
DimPlot(mpn_processed_hsc_fullcc, group.by = clust_col_preview,
        reduction = "umap.nn", split.by = "sample.name",
        label = TRUE, label.size = 7) +
  NoLegend() + labs(title = "HSC clusters split by condition")
```

Replicate structure: rows are HTO pseudo-replicates (`dm2_class`), columns are conditions (`sample.name`). This shows whether each pseudo-replicate within a condition covers the same cell-state landscape.

```{r preview-umap-dm2-facet, fig.height=10, fig.width=15}
umap_df <- cbind(
  Embeddings(mpn_processed_hsc_fullcc, "umap.nn"),
  mpn_processed_hsc_fullcc@meta.data[, c("dm2_class", "sample.name", clust_col_preview)]
) |> as.data.frame()
colnames(umap_df)[1:2] <- c("UMAP1", "UMAP2")
umap_df$dm2_class   <- factor(umap_df$dm2_class)
umap_df$sample.name <- factor(umap_df$sample.name)

ggplot(umap_df, aes(UMAP1, UMAP2, colour = .data[[clust_col_preview]])) +
  geom_point(size = 0.2, alpha = 0.4) +
  facet_grid(dm2_class ~ sample.name) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL, colour = "Cluster") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
  theme(axis.text = element_blank(), axis.ticks = element_blank(),
        panel.grid = element_blank(),
        strip.text = element_text(size = 9)) +
  guides(colour = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 3, alpha = 1), nrow = 4))
```

# Milo differential abundance {#sec-milo-da}

Differential abundance (DA) of HSC cell neighbourhoods between genotype groups. Each neighbourhood is a cell's KNN community in PCA space. logFC \> 0 means enriched in the mutant condition. Two pairwise contrasts vs WT: `Het mChNeg − WT` and `Het mChPos − WT`.

```{r hsc-milo-load}
targets::tar_load(names = c(milo_hsc_da, milo_hsc_obj, milo_hsc_cell_scores))
```

## Beeswarm plots

::: panel-tabset
### mChNeg vs WT

```{r hsc-milo-beeswarm-neg, fig.height=7, fig.width=10}
plot_milo_contrasts_single(milo_hsc_da$mChNeg_vs_WT)
```

### mChPos vs WT

```{r hsc-milo-beeswarm-pos, fig.height=7, fig.width=10}
plot_milo_contrasts_single(milo_hsc_da$mChPos_vs_WT)
```
:::

## Neighbourhood LFC scatter

Scatter of per-neighbourhood logFC for both contrasts. Each point is one neighbourhood; colour = local density.

::: panel-tabset
### All neighbourhoods

```{r hsc-nhood-lfc-scatter-all, fig.height=5, fig.width=6}
clust_col <- milo_hsc_da$mChNeg_vs_WT$cluster_col
lfc_nhood_scatter(
  milo_hsc_da$mChNeg_vs_WT$da_results,
  milo_hsc_da$mChPos_vs_WT$da_results,
  clust_col = clust_col,
  title = "All neighbourhoods"
)
```

### By cluster group

```{r hsc-nhood-lfc-scatter-by-clust, fig.height=10, fig.width=14}
clust_groups <- list(
  "No enrichment" = c("0","10","11","12","13","15","17","18","19"),
  "Erythroid"     = c("3","7","9"),
  "Mk"            = c("1","4"),
  "Intermediate"     = c("2","5"),
  "Muy stem-cells"         = c("6","8")
)

purrr::imap(clust_groups, function(clusts, label) {
  lfc_nhood_scatter(
    milo_hsc_da$mChNeg_vs_WT$da_results,
    milo_hsc_da$mChPos_vs_WT$da_results,
    clust_col = clust_col,
    subset_clusts = clusts,
    title = paste0(label, "  [", paste(sort(clusts), collapse = ", "), "]")
  )
}) |> patchwork::wrap_plots(ncol = 3)
```

### By individual cluster

```{r hsc-nhood-lfc-scatter-by-indiv, fig.height=40, fig.width=14}
all_clusts <- sort(as.integer(unique(as.character(
  milo_hsc_da$mChNeg_vs_WT$da_results[[clust_col]]))))
purrr::map(all_clusts, function(cl) {
  lfc_nhood_scatter(
    milo_hsc_da$mChNeg_vs_WT$da_results,
    milo_hsc_da$mChPos_vs_WT$da_results,
    clust_col     = clust_col,
    subset_clusts = as.character(cl),
    title         = paste("Cluster", cl)
  )
}) |> patchwork::wrap_plots(ncol = 3)
```
:::

## Volcano

Per-neighbourhood volcano plot (logFC vs −log₁₀ spatial FDR).

::: panel-tabset
### mChNeg vs WT

```{r hsc-milo-volcano-neg, fig.height=5, fig.width=6}
da_vol <- milo_hsc_da$mChNeg_vs_WT$da_results %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    sig  = SpatialFDR < 0.1,
    dir  = dplyr::case_when(
             sig & logFC > 0 ~ "Enriched in mChNeg",
             sig & logFC < 0 ~ "Depleted in mChNeg",
             TRUE            ~ "n.s."),
    neg_log_fdr = -log10(SpatialFDR)
  )
ggplot(da_vol, aes(logFC, neg_log_fdr, colour = dir)) +
  geom_point(size = 1.4, alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.1), linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey50") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey50") +
  scale_colour_manual(
    values = c("Enriched in mChNeg" = "#B2182B",
               "Depleted in mChNeg" = "#2166AC",
               "n.s."              = "grey70"),
    name = "") +
  labs(x = "log2 FC (mChNeg vs WT)",
       y = expression(-log[10](spatial~FDR)),
       title = "HSC Milo — mChNeg vs WT") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
  theme(legend.position = "top")
```

### mChPos vs WT

```{r hsc-milo-volcano-pos, fig.height=5, fig.width=6}
da_vol <- milo_hsc_da$mChPos_vs_WT$da_results %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    sig  = SpatialFDR < 0.1,
    dir  = dplyr::case_when(
             sig & logFC > 0 ~ "Enriched in mChPos",
             sig & logFC < 0 ~ "Depleted in mChPos",
             TRUE            ~ "n.s."),
    neg_log_fdr = -log10(SpatialFDR)
  )
ggplot(da_vol, aes(logFC, neg_log_fdr, colour = dir)) +
  geom_point(size = 1.4, alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.1), linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey50") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey50") +
  scale_colour_manual(
    values = c("Enriched in mChPos" = "#B2182B",
               "Depleted in mChPos" = "#2166AC",
               "n.s."              = "grey70"),
    name = "") +
  labs(x = "log2 FC (mChPos vs WT)",
       y = expression(-log[10](spatial~FDR)),
       title = "HSC Milo — mChPos vs WT") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
  theme(legend.position = "top")
```
:::

------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Limitations

-   The detection of opposing pattern of differential abundance within the same cluster indicates under clustering. Thus, new cluster need to be either defined at higher resolution or incorporate milo score in cluster definition.

-   

# Conclusion

Milo identified a set of neighbourhoods significantly enriched in mCh+ and mCh- cells. The neighbourhood logFC scores and the group-level analysis provide a bridge to downstream gene-expression analysis.

# Extra

## Milo cell scores {#sec-milo-cell-scores}

Milo neighbourhood logFC aggregated to per-cell mean scores via the cells × nhoods membership matrix. Visualised on the HSC UMAP and correlated to SCT gene expression.

```{r hsc-cell-scores-load, eval=FALSE}
targets::tar_load(mpn_processed_hsc_fullcc)
```

```{r hsc-cell-scores-add, eval=FALSE}
milo_tests_scores_df <- names(milo_hsc_cell_scores) %>%
  lapply(function(x) {
    new_name <- paste0("mean_lfc_", x)
    milo_hsc_cell_scores[[x]] %>% dplyr::rename(!!sym(new_name) := "mean_lfc")
  }) %>%
  purrr::reduce(inner_join) %>%
  tibble::column_to_rownames("cell_id")

mpn_processed_hsc_fullcc <- Seurat::AddMetaData(mpn_processed_hsc_fullcc,
                                                milo_tests_scores_df)
mpn_processed_hsc_fullcc$mean_lfc_mChPos_vs_WT_all_rank <-
  rank(mpn_processed_hsc_fullcc$mean_lfc_mChPos_vs_WT)
mpn_processed_hsc_fullcc$mean_lfc_mChNeg_vs_WT_all_rank <-
  rank(mpn_processed_hsc_fullcc$mean_lfc_mChNeg_vs_WT)
```

```{r hsc-cell-scores-umap, eval=FALSE, fig.height=5, fig.width=12}
p1 <- FeaturePlot(mpn_processed_hsc_fullcc, "mean_lfc_mChPos_vs_WT", reduction = "umap.nn") +
  ggplot2::scale_color_gradient2(low = "blue", mid = "white", high = "red") +
  labs(title = "mCh+ vs WT — mean neighbourhood LFC")

p2 <- FeaturePlot(mpn_processed_hsc_fullcc, "mean_lfc_mChNeg_vs_WT", reduction = "umap.nn") +
  ggplot2::scale_color_gradient2(low = "blue", mid = "white", high = "red") +
  labs(title = "mCh− vs WT — mean neighbourhood LFC")

p1 | p2
```

```{r hsc-cell-scores-scatter, eval=FALSE, fig.height=5, fig.width=6}
FeatureScatter(mpn_processed_hsc_fullcc,
               "mean_lfc_mChPos_vs_WT", "mean_lfc_mChNeg_vs_WT")
```

## Genes correlated to Milo score {.unnumbered}

Top genes positively and negatively correlated to the mChPos vs WT mean neighbourhood LFC score (Spearman, variable features only).

```{r hsc-group-correlation, eval=FALSE, fig.height=10, fig.width=18}
mpn_processed_hsc_fullcc[["SCT"]]@meta.features <-
  data.frame(row.names = rownames(mpn_processed_hsc_fullcc[["SCT"]]))

mpn_processed_hsc_fullcc <- Seurat::GroupCorrelation(
  mpn_processed_hsc_fullcc,
  assay   = "SCT",
  var     = "mean_lfc_mChPos_vs_WT_all_rank",
  slot    = "data",
  do.plot = FALSE
)

tar_load(sex_degs)

cor_genes <- mpn_processed_hsc_fullcc[["SCT"]]@meta.features %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column("gene") %>%
  mutate(dir = ifelse(mean_lfc_mChPos_vs_WT_all_rank_cor > 0, "up", "down")) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(dir, desc(abs(mean_lfc_mChPos_vs_WT_all_rank_cor))) %>%
  filter(!is.na(dir) &
         gene %in% VariableFeatures(mpn_processed_hsc_fullcc) &
         !gene %in% sex_degs)

genes_cor <- cor_genes %>% group_by(dir) %>% slice_head(n = 23) %>% pull(gene)

FeaturePlot(mpn_processed_hsc_fullcc,
            features = c("mean_lfc_mChPos_vs_WT_all_rank", genes_cor),
            ncol = 8) &
  scale_color_viridis_c(option = "turbo") &
  NoLegend()
```

```{r hsc-cell-scores-cleanup, eval=FALSE}
rm(mpn_processed_hsc_fullcc); invisible(gc(verbose = FALSE))
```

## Neighbourhood grouping {#sec-nhood-groups}

Significant DA neighbourhoods grouped by overlap (`groupNhoods`) for mChPos vs WT and mChNeg vs WT contrasts. Groups are projected back to the cell UMAP.

```{r hsc-nhood-groups}
da_fdr <- 0.1
da_pos_groups <- miloR::groupNhoods(milo_hsc_obj,
                                    milo_hsc_da$mChPos_vs_WT$da_results,
                                    compute.new = FALSE,
                                    da.fdr = da_fdr)
da_neg_groups <- miloR::groupNhoods(milo_hsc_obj,
                                    milo_hsc_da$mChNeg_vs_WT$da_results,
                                    compute.new = FALSE,
                                    da.fdr = da_fdr)
```

```{r hsc-nhood-groups-plot, fig.height=5, fig.width=12}
plt_pos <- plot_nhood_graph_groups(milo_hsc_obj, da_pos_groups,
                                   colour_by = "NhoodGroup", layout = "umap.nn") +
  ggtitle("mChPos vs WT")
plt_neg <- plot_nhood_graph_groups(milo_hsc_obj, da_neg_groups,
                                   colour_by = "NhoodGroup", layout = "umap.nn") +
  ggtitle("mChNeg vs WT")
plt_pos | plt_neg
```

```{r hsc-nhood-groups-umap, fig.height=5, fig.width=6}
targets::tar_load(mpn_processed_hsc_fullcc)

nhood_mat    <- miloR::nhoods(milo_hsc_obj)
grp_vec      <- setNames(da_pos_groups$NhoodGroup, as.character(da_pos_groups$Nhood))
grp_aligned  <- as.numeric(grp_vec[as.character(seq_len(ncol(nhood_mat)))])
grp_mat      <- model.matrix(~ factor(grp_aligned) - 1)
colnames(grp_mat) <- levels(factor(grp_aligned))
cell_grp_mat <- nhood_mat %*% grp_mat
cell_grp_vec <- apply(cell_grp_mat, 1, which.max)

mpn_processed_hsc_fullcc$milo_ngb_grps <- cell_grp_vec
DimPlot(mpn_processed_hsc_fullcc, group.by = "milo_ngb_grps",
        label = TRUE, reduction = "umap.nn") &
  NoLegend() &
  labs(title = "mChPos DA groups on cell UMAP")
```

```{r, eval=FALSE}
da_pos_results_1.2 <- miloR::annotateNhoods(

  da.res      = milo_hsc_da$mChPos_vs_WT$da_results[,1:8],

  )

da_neg_results_1.2 <- miloR::annotateNhoods(

  da.res      = milo_hsc_da$mChNeg_vs_WT$da_results[,1:8],
  coldata_col = "sNN_pca.SCT_30_res.1.2"
  )
```

```{r, eval=FALSE}
da_fdr <- 0.1
da_pos_groups_1.2 <- miloR::groupNhoods(milo_hsc_obj,
                                    da_pos_results_1.2,
                                    compute.new = FALSE,
                                    da.fdr = da_fdr)
da_neg_groups_1.2 <- miloR::groupNhoods(milo_hsc_obj,
                                    da_neg_results_1.2,

```

